scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && node scripts/package-hostinger.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
